role_summary: Senior technology strategy, architecture, and operations leadership role for GWAM Asia. Serves as Chief Architect, ensuring regional technology direction aligns with global strategy, leads architecture governance, promotes AI adoption, and shapes shared technology services.
must_have_requirements: University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
Strong architecture experience across enterprise, solution, application, data, integration, cloud, security, and modern engineering practices
Strong passion for AI and emerging technology with ability to translate AI concepts into practical business and technology outcomes
Proven track record of applying AI in real business or technology contexts, including AI application delivery, agent deployment, or AI-enabled workflow transformation

Strong knowledge of SDLC in the AI development era, including AI-assisted engineering, model and agent lifecycle considerations, responsible AI controls, testing, monitoring, change management, and production readiness
Demonstrated ability to lead architecture governance forums and make balanced decisions across business value, technology fit, risk, cost, scalability, and operational resilience
Strong understanding of shared technology services, reusable platforms, engineering standards, and operating models across multiple markets or business lines
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills across senior leaders, architects, engineers, risk partners, and business stakeholders
Strong strategic thinking with ability to connect global direction, regional priorities, and local market realities into a clear and practical technology roadmap
Inquisitive, pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset with continuous improvement and constructive challenge of status quo
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience in asset management, wealth management, or retirement technology
Experience with responsible AI governance frameworks and operationalization
Knowledge of Asia market technology ecosystems and regulatory environments
Experience overseeing operations technology capabilities and balancing modernization with stability
soft_skills_priority: Stakeholder management and influencing without formal authority

scoring_criteria.name: Architecture Experience & Breadth
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core of the role requires deep and broad architecture expertise across enterprise, solution, data, integration, cloud, security.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Years as architect in financial services
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have depth in one area but lack breadth across all domains.

scoring_criteria.name: AI Practical Application
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: JD emphasizes AI adoption with proven track record in real business/technology contexts, not just theoretical knowledge.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have AI awareness but lack hands-on delivery or enterprise-scale deployment.

scoring_criteria.name: AI SDLC & Governance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Critical to ensure AI solutions are production-ready, governed, and aligned with risk standards.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may focus on model development without addressing operational governance.

scoring_criteria.name: Architecture Governance Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Leading LARB requires ability to make balanced decisions and enforce standards across varied stakeholders.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Decision-making examples balancing value, risk, cost
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have participated in governance but not led it.

scoring_criteria.name: Shared Technology Services & Platform Strategy
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Key responsibility to drive reusable capabilities across Asia, reducing duplication and improving consistency.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have built siloed solutions but not led cross-market shared services.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Management & Influence
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role relies heavily on influencing without formal authority across senior leaders, markets, and global teams.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Testimonials or examples of influencing C-level
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have strong technical skills but limited influencing evidence.

scoring_criteria.name: Strategic Thinking & Roadmap Creation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must connect global strategy with regional and local realities to produce actionable roadmaps.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may focus on tactical execution rather than strategic planning.

scoring_criteria.name: Operations Technology Oversight
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Oversight of Asia operations technology requires balancing stability with modernization.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may come from pure development or architecture without operations background.

scoring_criteria.name: Communication & Soft Skills
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Essential for coaching, storytelling, and building consensus across diverse teams.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have strong technical credentials but limited evidence of soft skills.

summary_focus: Chief Architect/leadership role in financial services
Regional Asia technology strategy and governance
AI adoption and responsible AI in enterprise
Shared platform and operations technology oversight
do_not_overclaim: Overclaiming AI experience without tangible production examples
Stating 'led architecture governance' without specifying role or outcomes
Claiming shared services expertise without multi-market evidence

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position as a senior technology leader who combines deep architecture expertise with a hands-on approach to AI adoption and governance, emphasizing ability to influence across Asia markets and align with global strategy
bridge_gaps_honestly: If limited AI production experience, acknowledge awareness of AI lifecycle and governance and emphasize eagerness to apply it
If limited Asia market exposure, highlight experience with multi-regional architecture and adaptability
If lacking operations oversight, stress architecture focus on resilience and service effectiveness
